__comment: Copy this to providers.json (git-ignored) and fill in real values. Only providers with a clientId are advertised to the app. Discovery is automatic from `issuer`; you can override authorization_endpoint / token_endpoint / jwks_uri if a provider lacks a discovery document.

github.name: GitHub
github.note: GitHub OAuth is not OIDC — use a provider that issues OIDC id_tokens, or front GitHub with an OIDC bridge. Left here as a placeholder.

apple.name: Apple
apple.note: Apple's clientSecret is a short-lived ES256 JWT you generate from your Apple key; Apple uses response_mode=form_post.
